walkthroughs.body_html:
Muslims believe Allah sent thousands of prophets — 25 are named in the Qur'an.

Key prophets include Adam, Nuh (Noah), Ibrahim (Abraham), Musa (Moses), Dawud (David), Isa (Jesus) and finally Muhammad ﷺ — the Seal of the Prophets (Qur'an 33:40).

All prophets brought the same core message: worship one God.

Muslims believe Allah revealed several holy books (Kutub):

- Tawrat (Torah) to Musa
- Zabur (Psalms) to Dawud
- Injil (Gospel) to Isa
- Qur'an to Muhammad ﷺ

The Qur'an, revealed over 23 years from 610 CE, is the final, unchanged word of Allah.

Angels (Malaikah) are made of light and serve Allah perfectly.

Jibril (Gabriel) brought revelation. Mikail (Michael) brings sustenance. Israfil will blow the trumpet at the end of time. Izrail takes souls at death.

On Yawm al-Qiyamah all are judged — bound for Jannah (paradise) or Jahannam (hell).
